title: Homogeneity of coordinate projection
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let $c\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$. Then the coordinate projection satisfies $P_J(cf)=cP_Jf$.
